headline: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
summary: OpenAI has reportedly dissolved its preparedness team, responsible for assessing and mitigating AI risks. This team focused on potential dangers like AI models going rogue or hacking other companies. The Financial Times broke the story, indicating the team's responsibilities are now distributed.

headline: Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal crafted a hip hop breakup masterpiece
summary: Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal's album "DOOMED!" is hailed as a hip-hop masterpiece about breakups. The record explores the emotional complexities of separation, a recurring theme in Eagle's personal work. Critics praise Eagle's ability to find artistic depth in a common, yet painful, subject.

headline: Amazon is trying to crush class-action suits before they get started
summary: Amazon updated its terms and conditions, introducing mandatory arbitration for disputes. The new terms include a class-action waiver, aiming to prevent group lawsuits. Amazon frames this as "fast and efficient" dispute resolution, but critics see it as an attempt to limit legal recourse.

headline: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
summary: ChatGPT's new macOS desktop app features "Computer History" to learn user habits. This feature tracks clicks and keystrokes, turning user actions into training data. It aims to suggest automations and assist with unfinished tasks by referencing a timeline of activity.

headline: Heroes Star Hayden Panettiere Dies at 36
summary: Heroes star Hayden Panettiere has reportedly passed away at the age of 36. The former child actor's career in entertainment spanned three decades. The news was reported by IGN.

headline: Lanterns Showrunner Says That Episode 1 Surprise Ending Was ‘Big and Scary’ to Commit To
summary: Chris Mundy, showrunner for DC's new "Lanterns" series, discussed the show's first episode. He revealed that the surprise ending of Episode 1 was a "big and scary" creative decision to commit to. The series is part of James Gunn's vision for the DC universe.

headline: 'Look Forward to Meetin' Ya, Sugah!' — Rogue Voice Actress Lenore Zann Reacts to MCU X-Men Casting With Special Video Message for Inde Navarrette
summary: Lenore Zann, the iconic voice of Rogue in '90s Marvel animations, published a special video message. She congratulated Inde Navarrette on being confirmed to play the live-action Rogue in the MCU X-Men reboot. Zann's message included a nod to Rogue's famous catchphrase.

headline: Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Sparks Theories About 2 Doctor Dooms as Fans Hope for a Surprise Cameo from Cillian Murphy
summary: The new "Avengers: Doomsday" trailer has sparked various fan theories online. Some fans believe clues in the trailer suggest the film might feature two different Doctor Dooms. There's also speculation and hope for a surprise cameo from actor Cillian Murphy.

headline: Trump envoy Kushner meets Hamas leader to push Gaza peace plan
summary: Trump envoy Jared Kushner held a rare meeting with a Hamas leader. The meeting aimed to push Donald Trump's proposed Gaza peace plan forward. This engagement comes a week after Israel had rejected Trump's initial peace proposal.

headline: Actress Hayden Panettiere dies aged 36, US media report
summary: US media outlets are reporting the death of actress Hayden Panettiere at age 36. A representative for the actress confirmed the news to US outlets. No further details about her death were immediately provided.

headline: UK to turn cooler with rain after exceptional heat and dry spell
summary: The UK is set to experience a significant weather change, turning cooler with expected rain. This comes after an exceptional summer marked by heatwaves and a prolonged dry spell. Simon King explained the shift, indicating a break from recent weather conditions.

headline: Five teenagers dead and four injured after car drives on wrong side of motorway
summary: A tragic collision on the M9 Northbound in County Kildare resulted in five teenage fatalities. Four other individuals sustained injuries in the incident. The crash occurred around 03:00 local time on Sunday, caused by a car driving on the wrong side of the motorway.
